title: scTHS-seq Protocol for Transposon Sequencing
author: Kun Zhang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xf8fjrw
materials: Generate 384 annealed transposons 7 µL, Indexed Tn5 top strand (100uM) 7 µL, 5' phosphorylated mosaic end sequence bottom strand (100uM) Combine top and bottom strand oligos in a PCR tube. In a thermocycler, incubate for 2 minutes at 95 °C then ramp to 14 °C at a rate of -0.1 °C per second.
After last wash, completely remove all ethanol and transfer to a heated thermomixer to dry 37 °C 00:01:00

Generate annealed transposons 40 µL, i7 top strand (100uM) 40 µL, 5' phosphorylated mosaic end sequence bottom strand (100uM) Combine top and bottom strand oligos in a PCR tube. In a thermocycler, incubate for 2 minutes at 95 °C then ramp to 14 °C at a rate of -0.1 °C per second.
Make 3.045 mL transposons dilution buffer 2345 µL, 75% glycerol/0.3% TritonX-100 700 µL, Qiagen EB
Preheat hotstart polymerase mix 250 µL, KAPA HiFi Hotstart ReadyMix, 2X 98 °C, Thermocycler 00:00:45 Cool immediately on ice
Preheat hotstart polymerase mix 12000 µL, KAPA HiFi Hotstart ReadyMix, 2X 98 °C, Thermocycler 00:00:45 Cool immediately on ice
Quantify each pool using dsDNA HS Qubit

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Buffers
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary buffers and stock solutions for the protocol.

substeps.instruction: Make 1000 µL transposase dilution buffer: 667 µL 75% glycerol/0.3% TritonX-100, 1 µL DTT (1M), 6.25 µL Tris-HCl (4M, pH 7.5), and 325.75 µL nuclease free water.
Make 10 mL 75% glycerol with 0.3% tritonX-100: 9.45 g Glycerol (100%), 300 µL TritonX-100 (10%), and 2200 µL nuclease free water.
Make 10 mL of 1.5X D6 buffer: 1500 µL Tango Buffer (10X), 2400 µL DMF (100%), and 6100 µL nuclease free water.

Make 10 mL of 1X lysis buffer: 25 µL Tris-HCl (4M, pH 7.5), 20 µL Sodium chloride (5M), 15 µL Magnesium chloride (2M), 100 µL IGEPAL-630 (10%), 2000 µL BSA (10%), 1000 µL PBS (10X), 6840 µL nuclease free water, and 1 protease inhibitor tablet (EDTA-free).
Make 10 mL of 2X FACS buffer: 1000 µL PBS (10X), 2000 µL BSA (10%), 80 µL EDTA (0.5M), and 6920 µL nuclease free water.

steps.title: Prepare Initial Transposomes
steps.instruction: Prepare the transposase complex for the first tagmentation step.

substeps.instruction: Make 420 µL of 4.8 µM transposase Tn5-059: 252 µL transposase Tn5-059 (8 µM) and 168 µL transposase dilution buffer.
Dilute annealed transposons: 1 µL Annealed transposons and 6.7 µL transposon dilution buffer.
Load transposomes: Mix 1 µL 4.8 µM transposase Tn5-059 and 1 µL diluted annealed transposons (6.5 µM).
Incubate at 22 °C in a thermocycler for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Cell/Nuclei Preparation and Tagmentation
steps.instruction: Process cells or nuclei and perform the first round of tagmentation.

substeps.instruction: Wash nuclei or cell suspension with ice-cold PBS.
Pellet 400,000 cells/nuclei by centrifuging at 330 RCF (cells) or 900 RCF (nuclei).
Resuspend 400,000 cells/nuclei in 1X lysis buffer (use 100 µL per 100,000 cells/nuclei).
Resuspend nuclei in 100 µL 1.5X D6 buffer initially; count and add more 1.5X D6 buffer to achieve ~250 nuclei/µL.
Aliquot 4.0 µL of cells in 1.5X D6 buffer into wells containing 2.0 µL of prepared transposomes.
Incubate at 37 °C in a thermocycler for 15 minutes.
Terminate the tagmentation reaction by adding 4 µL of 50 mM EDTA.
Store cells at -20 °C overnight or until ready to sort.

steps.title: FACS Sorting
steps.instruction: Sort the tagmented cells/nuclei into individual wells.

substeps.instruction: Coat 12 x 200 µL tubes and 1 x 15 mL conical tube using 1X FACS buffer; let sit for 1 hour.
Add 1 volume (10 µL) ice cold 2X FACS buffer to each sample well containing cells in tagmentation mix.
Centrifuge at 500 RCF at 4 °C.
Resuspend nuclei in 1.5 mL 1X FACS buffer.
Add 75 µL Propidium Iodide stain for sorting.
Add 10 µL PBS to each well of 10 to 15 x 96-well plates; cover and store on ice.
Sort 100 cells into each well using BD Influx, removing doublets via forward/side scatter and selecting for PI-staining events.
Pool all samples from the 15 mL conical tube into 12 x 200 µL tubes using a multichannel pipette.

steps.title: DNA Release and Gap Filling
steps.instruction: Lyse the sorted nuclei and perform gap filling on the DNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 11 µL of 8M guanidine chloride to each well to lyse nuclei and release DNA.
Add 30 µL of KAPA Pure Beads (Roche #07983298001) to each well to bind DNA.
Mix well and bind for at least 8 minutes at room temperature.
Place plate on magnet for at least 3 minutes and discard supernatant.
Wash beads twice with 170 µL of freshly prepared 80% ethanol while on the magnet.
Add 8 µL of nuclease free water to each well.
Add 2 µL of 5X Taq Master Mix (NEB #M0285L) for gap filling.
Incubate plates at 72 °C for 8 minutes.

steps.title: In Vitro Transcription (IVT)
steps.instruction: Perform IVT to amplify the DNA into RNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 µL of HiScribe T7 IVT reaction components (T7 buffer 10X, UTP, GTP, ATP, CTP, and T7 RNA Polymerase) to each well.
Incubate at 37 °C in a thermocycler for 16 hours.

steps.title: First Strand cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Convert the IVT RNA back into first-strand cDNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 40 µL of KAPA Pure Beads (Roche #07983298001) to each well to bind DNA.
Mix well and bind for at least 8 minutes at room temperature.
Place plate on magnet for at least 3 minutes and discard supernatant.
Wash beads twice with 170 µL of freshly prepared 80% ethanol while on the magnet.
Add 9 µL of nuclease free water to each well.
Add 2.5 µL of 20 µM random hexamers.
Incubate at 70 °C in a thermocycler for 3 minutes, then cool immediately on ice.
Add 9.5 µL of MMLV RT mixture (5X First strand buffer, 100 µM each Advantage UltraPure dNTPs, 100mM DTT, and MMLV RT).
Incubate in a thermocycler at 22 °C for 10 minutes, 42 °C for 1 hour, and 70 °C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Second Strand cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Synthesize the second strand of cDNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µL of RNase H (prepared with 125.28 µL RNase H 5 Units/µL and 1127.52 µL nuclease-free water).
Incubate in thermocycler at 37 °C for 20 minutes.
Add 2.5 µL of 20 µM second strand synthesis primer (sss_scnXTv2).
Incubate in thermocycler at 65 °C for 2 minutes, then cool immediately on ice.
Add 5.9 µL 5X Taq Master Mix.
Incubate in thermocycler at 72 °C for 8 minutes.

steps.title: Second Round Tagmentation
steps.instruction: Perform a second round of tagmentation on the double-stranded cDNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 40 µL of KAPA Pure Beads (Roche #07983298001) to each well to bind DNA.
Mix well and bind for at least 8 minutes at room temperature.
Place plate on magnet for at least 3 minutes and discard supernatant.
Wash beads twice with 170 µL of freshly prepared 80% ethanol while on the magnet.
Add 4 µL of 1.5X tagmentation buffer (prepared with 3172 µL nuclease-free water, 780 µL Tango Buffer 10X, and 1248 µL DMF 100%).

Prepare second-round transposomes: Dilute 74 µL Annealed transposons into 1026 µL transposon dilution buffer; make 420 µL of 2.4 µM transposase Tn5-059 (330 µL 8 µM Tn5-059 and 770 µL dilution buffer).
Load transposomes: Mix 1100 µL 2.4 µM transposase Tn5-059 and 1100 µL diluted annealed transposons (6.5 µM).
Incubate at 22 °C in a thermocycler for 30 minutes.
Add 2 µL of loaded transposomes to each well.
Incubate at 55 °C in a thermocycler for 6 minutes, then cool immediately on ice.

steps.title: Library Purification and qPCR Testing
steps.instruction: Purify the tagmented DNA and determine the optimal PCR cycle number.

substeps.instruction: Add 6 µL 8M guanidine hydrochloride to each well.
Add 30 µL of KAPA Pure Beads (Roche #07983298001) to each well to bind DNA.
Mix well and bind for at least 8 minutes at room temperature.
Place plate on magnet for at least 3 minutes and discard supernatant.
Wash beads twice with 170 µL of freshly prepared 80% ethanol while on the magnet.
Add 16 µL nuclease free water to each well.
Prepare a master mix for qPCR: Add primers to a final concentration of 417 nM each (42 µL i5XX 5 µM and 42 µL i7XX 5 µM) and 0.8X final SYBR Green (4 µL 100X SYBR Green).
Aliquot 8 µL of amplification mix to each well of a qPCR plate.
Sample 5 wells from each plate (4 µL each), including a no-nuclei control well.
Perform qPCR (72C 5min; then 20 cycles of 98C 30s, 59C 30s, 72C 1min; final 72C 5min). Terminate when samples reach exponential phase (usually 6-8 cycles).
Assess products on a 6% TBE PAGE gel to determine the correct cycle number.

steps.title: Final Library Amplification
steps.instruction: Perform the final PCR amplification of the library.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 12 µL of preheated KAPA HiFi ReadyMix to each well of a new PCR plate.
Aliquot 2 µL of 16 different 5 µM s5XX primers to each set of 2 plates (one per row).
Aliquot 2 µL of 12 different 5 µM s7XX primers to each column of every plate (one per column).
Transfer 8 µL of sample to each well of the PCR plate.
Perform PCR using the cycles determined by test PCR (72C 5min; then XX cycles of 98C 30s, 59C 30s, 72C 1min; final 72C 5min).

steps.title: Library Pooling and Size Selection
steps.instruction: Pool the amplified libraries and perform size selection.

substeps.instruction: Pool 4 µL from each well from 2 plates with non-overlapping s5XX primers (approx. 800 µL per pool, 5 pools total).
Add 800 µL of KAPA Pure Beads (Roche #07983298001) to each pool to bind DNA.
Mix well and bind for at least 8 minutes at room temperature.
Place on magnet for at least 3 minutes and discard supernatant.
Wash beads twice with 1000 µL of freshly prepared 80% ethanol while on the magnet.
Add 20 µL of nuclease free water to each pool.
Perform gel size selection for 220-1000 bp using 6% TBE PAGE (5-well gel, loading ~1 µg library per well).
